messages:
Rhea: quick check-in about the signal-gatekeeper idea for canaries. want a lightweight mediator that takes aggregated signals and emits safe mitigation actions.
Omar: agreed. prefer mediator to be "stupid" rule-evaluator + merge rules rather than doing heavy ML decisions.
Kai: key constraints: privacy (no raw payloads), idempotency of actions, and easy rollback.
Leah: proposal: observers (at edge) compute metrics and sign compact summaries -> mediator consumes these summaries. mediator runs policy and emits actions with provenance.
Rhea: action model: {action_id, type, target_release, effect_pct, issuer, precedence, ttl}. precedence order: operator > release-owner > auto-policy.
Omar: merge rule: for same target and action type, highest precedence + highest effect_pct wins; for conflicting types (reduce_traffic vs route_to_fallback) prefer lower-disruption first unless catastrophic signal.
Kai: define "catastrophic": errors > 5% or 5xx spike > 3x baseline in 1m. single catastrophic signal should be allowed to abort immediately.
Leah: add rate limits: max 2 traffic-change actions per 15m per release, with exponential cooldown. prevents oscillation.
Rhea: policy authoring: small declarative DSL (YAML/JSON) attached to rollout config. examples: `- when: err_rate>2% for 3m then: reduce_traffic 30` and `- when: catastrophic then: abort`.
Omar: include a "suggest-only" mode where mediator posts actions to audit topic but doesn't execute. required for 24-48h shadow runs.
Kai: testing: simulator that replays historical aggregated signals through the mediator logic and reports FP/FN counts and action churn.
Leah: ops guard: sheriff override token that injects operator-level precedence and emits force-safe action. UI should show lineage and hashes for forensic replay.
Rhea: follow-ups: (1) write mediator merge semantics doc, (2) draft minimal DSL and compiler plan, (3) simulator + shadow-run checklist, (4) audit log schema (signed, aggregate). I'll open RFC and tag owners.
audit-bot: Note: canary rollout 3.1 started in eu-west at 10%. link: https://console/redwood/deploys/3001
Omar: i'll take simulator.
Kai: i'll sketch DSL grammar.
Leah: i'll mock ops UI and override path.
Rhea: thanks all — plan observe-only for this canary and collect suggested actions. we'll reconvene after 48h. :thumbsup:
